title: What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?
snippet:
A subscription on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai) and the API are two separate products with separate billing. Your plan, credits, and Unlimited access exist only on the website; the API runs on its own account balance in US dollars.
How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan?
| Criteria | Higgsfield plan ([higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/)) | Higgsfield API |
|---|---|---|
| Who it's for | Creators working in the visual interface | Developers building generation into their own products |
| Billing | Subscription plus credits | US dollar balance, pay per generation |
| Unlimited models | Yes, where included in plan | Not applicable |
| Requires the other | No | No |

title: How to Automate AI Video Generation With n8n and Make
snippet:
| Criteria | Higgsfield API | Higgsfield MCP |
|---|---|---|
| Account | Separate API account at open.higgsfield.ai | Your higgsfield.ai account |
| Billing | Prepaid API balance in US dollars, pay per generation | Plan credits at standard rates |
| Requirement | Funded balance, minimum top-up $5 | Active paid subscription |
| Authentication | API key, server-side only | OAuth sign-in, no key |
| Models | 50+ API catalog models | Website model lineup, including Veo 3.1 |
| Soul ID characters | Available, from $2.50 per request | Available |
| Where results land | File URL returned to your workflow | Assets on higgsfield.ai, plus a result URL |
| Fits | Client volume, production pipelines | Teams already on a Higgsfield plan |

Through MCP, the same generations deduct plan credits at standard rates, and $1 corresponds to 20 credits. Plans start at Starter for $15/mo, with Plus at $49/mo ($39 annual) and Ultra at $129/mo ($99 annual).

title: Creator Partnership Program: Apply Now | Higgsfield
snippet:
## Home to the creators shaping visual storytelling
A full Higgsfield plan renewed every month, credit support, tips and hands-on help growing your audience, and a direct line to Higgsfield.
## Everything you need to go further
### Create without limits
- Full Higgsfield plan, renewed every month
- Extra credits for films and series
- New models and features before public release
### Grow and get noticed
- Affiliate program to earn from your reach
- Your work featured across Higgsfield channels
- Playbooks and hands-on advice from the team
### Never create alone
- A dedicated Higgsfield contact, anytime
- Curated partner community across 35+ countries
- Challenges, spotlights and collabs

[The Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program](https://higgsfield.ai/blog/creator-partnership-program) is how Higgsfield backs the creators who are pushing AI content forward.

Applying is simple:
1. Fill out the application form on our site.
2. A real person on our team reviews every application.
3. There's no automated filter sorting people by follower count.
4. Everyone gets a response by email, whether it's a yes or a no.
5. If you're accepted, that email includes your next steps to get set up.

Six things, from day one:
1. A plan and credits, every month. A full Higgsfield plan that renews each month, plus extra credits for bigger projects, films, and series. You make the ambitious version of your idea, not the cut-down one.
2. Growth support. Real, hands-on advice from our team on growing your audience and sharpening your content. Tips and playbooks tailored to what you make.

Yes. The Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program is our take on a creative partner program. We say Creator because Higgsfield is a full creative suite, and the program is for everyone building with it.
CPP is our partnership program with a plan, credits, early access, and community. The Earn program at [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/) runs paid campaigns open to creators of any size, a good place to start if you want to work with us before applying to CPP. The two also work together: as a CPP partner, you can receive your own individual Earn campaigns on top of everything the program already gives you.
